_doc: Pueblo Motorsports Park through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; ONE-CHAIN §4 row 10, Kevin 2026-11-01: 'get a complete track list and installed by morning'). The draft is the engine's own on the OSM raceway ring (source.type from_track over source/osm_fixes.json, smooth_window 0: gps -> elev -> project -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso. Rehearsed offline 2026-11-01 up to elev (3DEP is unreachable from the cloud box): gps -> 3,511 m, 1,172 points from 128 OSM nodes, close_gap 350 m = the front straight's own last->first segment; with a zero-elevation stand-in the projection rotates the ring 952 points and vertex 0 lands 6.4 m from route.start_at, heading NNW, clockwise.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet: no pit lane (east of the front straight, ~350 m, _orientation_doc), no kerbs where the real ones are, no buildings, no race furniture. The engine-era T1 (ledger 0025, v0.66.3: 118 excursion drops fixed by the graded floor + measured lips) is withdrawn; the track enters at T0 through the chain. Read first on the Windows run: the gps print (3.51 km, close_gap 350, 1,172 points) and the projection's 'ring rotated by 952 points'; the mesh step's bridge-span line (a flat road course: any span is the detector reading the wrong ground, ledger 0060 High Plains); then drive_test's excursion drops (0025's mechanism sat at lateral 9.5-10 m; the prep now skips its conform on an engine draft).
